labels.name: Maisie's Galaxy
labels.note: One of the first z>11 galaxies spectroscopically confirmed by JWST; named after Finkelstein's daughter.

labels.name: CEERS-93316
labels.note: Famous z_phot~16.4 candidate later revised to a z=4.91 dusty galaxy - cautionary tale.

labels.name: CEERS 1019
labels.note: Hosted the most distant confirmed accreting SMBH at the time (z=8.68, 570 Myr after Big Bang); originally EGSY8p7.

labels.name: CEERS-2112
labels.note: Most distant barred spiral galaxy found; a young Milky-Way analog / progenitor at z=3.
